requirements.text: The system shall ensure secure authentication of users to prevent unauthorized access to attendance data.
The system shall implement a performance monitoring system that dynamically adjusts resource allocation based on current demand.
The system shall provide real-time data synchronization that prioritizes critical updates to maintain accurate attendance records.
The system shall maintain historical attendance data for a minimum of five academic years while ensuring compliance with data protection regulations.
The system shall implement a layered security approach that integrates with the performance monitoring system to ensure prioritized updates while maintaining robust encryption.
The system shall allow students to dispute attendance records through a formal process within 10 days of marking.
The system shall provide transparency in attendance recording by logging all attendance changes with timestamps and user identification.

conflict_resolutions.rationale: Real-time data synchronization is optimized to prioritize critical updates, balancing safety and efficiency.
Historical data retention is aligned with compliance to data protection regulations.
Layered security approach ensures auditability while allowing prioritized updates.
